value: MODEL_V2_NOT_PROMOTED_RELEASE_CI remains true: the release-seed paired VALIDATION CI lower bound crossed zero; permanent historical negative finding, not rewritten
INTERNAL_TEST has only six eligible contributing patient groups
V2-010 INTERNAL_TEST/INCART/NSTDB evidence is post-freeze second-look evidence, not untouched validation
INCART FL evaluation is project-exposed external second-look evidence
QUALITY_V1 does not reliably hard-fail a raw stuck-nonzero ECG source because of the frozen preprocessing composition (not repaired here)
CAL_V2 is MIT-BIH source-domain calibration only
SecAgg evidence is a narrow protected-aggregation-interface result, not a complete privacy guarantee
CLEAN_CLONE_GATING_V1 excluded raw-data-dependent tests from the clean-software claim when their untracked inputs were absent

facts.value: Raw `sigmoid(raw_logit)`, threshold 0.5 (`>=`, `FL_EVAL_RAW_THRESHOLD_0P5_V1`), PER_WINDOW_ZSCORE_V1 → float32 [1,2500]; **no CAL_V1/CAL_V2/temperature/threshold fitting; CALIBRATION not accessed**. Patient-cluster bootstrap B=2000, seed 20260927, PCG64, multiplicity preserved (6 slots/replicate INTERNAL_TEST; 32 INCART), no redraw, shared draws for every model and paired contrast; draws reproduce the frozen T018/T020 npz exactly; nominal 95% percentile CIs, no p-values, no multiplicity adjustment. One orchestration command, one guarded invocation per dataset (guards COMPLETED; a second begin raises `ALREADY_CONSUMED`; historical guards untouched).
